item.title: Ireland name their team to face Scotland
item.description: Head Coach Andy Farrell has named the Ireland Match Day Squad, for Saturday Six Nations finale against Scotland. Jamie Osborne, Rob Baloucoune and Tommy O’Brien start in the back three, with Stuart McCloskey and Garry Ringrose once again named in the midfield, while Jamison Gibson-Park and Jack Crowley link up in the half-backs. In the pack, Tom O’Toole, Dan Sheehan and Tadhg Furlong are named in the front row, with Joe McCarthy and Tadhg Beirne. Jack Conan is named to start at blindside flanker

item.title: Fuel Allowance extended in local working family payments
item.description: More people in Cavan and Monaghan will be eligible for the Fuel Allowance from today, accoding to local TD Deputy David Maxwell. The Fine Gael TD welcomed the extension of the scheme to those in receipt of the Working Family Payment, which will benefit families across both counties. In Cavan, 1,025 households are currently in receipt of the Fuel Allowance, while in Monaghan, 927 households benefit from the scheme. item.title: Cavan County Council calls for Larry Murrin removal
item.description: Cavan County Council this week became the 14th local authority to call for Larry Murrin to be removed from the role of Chairperson of Bord Bia. It comes as Mr. Murrin has stepped aside from his role as Bord Bia Chairman as a governance review takes place. Protests had been ongoing for weeks after it emerged that Murrin's company, Dawn Farms, imported Brazilian beef for use in some of its products. item.description: Gardaí in Monaghan Town are investigating a number of break-ins that occurred in recent weeks. Garda Tracey Donaghy is appealing for anyone with information regarding the crimes to come forward. Gardaí are investigating a break-in to a home in Belgian Park in Monaghan Town. item.description: St Louis Infant School in Monaghan Town has been recognised as a DCU Changemaker School, making it the only school in Co Monaghan to be recognised by the social innovation initiative. This prestigious initiative helps primary school teachers and students across Ireland to put in place and lead programmes of change in their respective schools and wider communities to address societal changes. item.description: A major economic and jobs boost could be on the cards for Monaghan. Award winning automated storage Moffett Automation looks to develop a 15,000 sq ft centre of excellence. item.title: Update expected on National Children's Hospital
item.description: Sinn Fein is accusing the Government of not holding the contractor of the National Children's Hospital to account over delays. The Health Minister is due to meet the CEO of BAM today to find out if the completion date of April 30th will be met. However, it's expected Jennifer Carroll MacNeill be told of another delay to the project.
